presets.name: Fleet default (example)
presets.description: EXAMPLE ONLY — an illustrative snapshot of one route (opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash, chat_completions, reasoning medium, one declared nous fallback). These are not fleet defaults and not a recommendation: the values may be stale or invalid on another install. Replace every value with your own before applying.

presets.name: Minimal route (example)
presets.description: EXAMPLE ONLY — the smallest useful shape: a main tier naming provider and model, with no reasoning_effort and no fallback, so applying it never touches agent.reasoning_effort or fallback_providers. The values are illustrative; replace them with your own.

presets.name: Config 3 (live fleet array, read 2026-09-17)
presets.description: A real selection array, not an example: per-profile assignments captured from a seven-profile fleet on 2026-09-17. proteus/frida: openai-codex / gpt-5.6-luna-900k; orda/hazen/shaka: opencode-go / muse-spark-1.3-contributor; leo/mozi: opencode-go / deepseek-v4.1-flash. Each assigned tier names the full route it has (provider, model, and — for the opencode-go routes — base_url and api_mode); agent.reasoning_effort and fallback_providers are deliberately not named, so an apply never touches them. Applying this preset to a profile it does NOT assign is refused — there is no fallback route and no guessing. A provider switch away from a route that set base_url/api_mode cannot clear those keys in v1 (no preset blanks a key), so verify after applying.
